utterance: The account already serves our product domain from a Route 53 zone for `example53.com`; only the answers under it are missing. Configure a routing policy that utilizes a user's location to route visitors to the nearest endpoint of that zone: visitors from North America (continent `NA`) must be answered with 192.0.2.101 and visitors from Europe (continent `EU`) with 192.0.2.102. Publish it on the zone's public service hostname, as plain address answers rather than alias records.

main.responsibility: owns the application's resources and their configuration
main.intent: in the Route 53 hosted zone the account already serves example53.com from, one public service hostname under that domain carries a geolocation record set of non-alias A records whose North America (NA) continent member answers 192.0.2.101 and whose Europe (EU) continent member answers 192.0.2.102
